ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail stack behavior for DUP and SWAP operations beyond basic push/pop.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume DUP and SWAP use peek operations or multiple pop/push sequences. These must respect the same 1024 limit and underflow checks.

ambiguities.text: Error handling behavior after StackOverflowError or StackUnderflowError is not fully specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume these errors cause immediate execution halt with all gas consumed, consistent with other EVM execution errors.

implicit_assumptions.description: The underlying Python list implementation handles append/pop operations atomically.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Race conditions could corrupt stack state in concurrent execution scenarios.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot bypass stack bounds checks through any combination of opcodes.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Stack corruption could enable arbitrary code execution or state manipulation.

implicit_assumptions.description: All U256 values can be safely stored and retrieved from the stack without loss.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Value truncation or corruption would break contract execution correctness.

implicit_assumptions.description: The 1024 stack limit is sufficient for all legitimate smart contract execution patterns.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Legitimate contracts could fail unexpectedly, but this is a design choice not a bug.
